project_name.justification: The primary project of interest is named in the title of the press release: 'Sorrento Resources Completes Acquisition of the Copper-Gold Lord Baron Project, Newfoundland'.

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as 'Sorrento Resources Ltd. (CSE: SRS) (OTCQB: SRSLF) (the "Company" or "Sorrento")' which 'completed the acquisition of a 100% undivided interest in the minerals licenses collectively representing the Lord Baron Project'.

ceo_buyer.justification: The press release is signed on behalf of the board by 'Brayden Sutton Chief Executive Officer'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: Sorrento 'completed the acquisition of a 100% undivided interest in the minerals licenses collectively representing the Lord Baron Project'.

primary_commodity.justification: The project is described in the headline as the 'Copper-Gold Lord Baron Project'.

verified_article_link.justification: The article at this link is titled 'Sorrento Resources Completes Acquisition of the Copper-Gold Lord Baron Project, Newfoundland', which directly pertains to the project of interest.

currency.justification: The cash consideration is given in '$' and the acquiring company, Sorrento Resources Ltd., is listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE), implying the currency is Canadian Dollars.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The transaction was completed for 'aggregate consideration of $47,500 in cash'.

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction involved the issuance of shares, but a total monetary value for the share component was not provided in the text.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The cash and share components of the transaction were listed separately, not as a single combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The consideration included 'the issuance of an aggregate of 4,300,000 common shares of the Company'.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants were mentioned as part of the transaction consideration.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned as part of the transaction consideration.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued (4,300,000), but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.11'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: No drilling commitment in meters was mentioned in the transaction terms.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: No exploration expenditure commitment was mentioned in the transaction terms.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: As part of the transaction, Sorrento agreed to 'the grant of 2% net smelter returns royalties to the underlying vendors of the various mineral licenses representing the Project.' This represents a royalty retained by the sellers.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The initial acquisition announcement states: 'The Project, consists of 13 individual mineral licenses made up of 226 individual claims for an area of 5,650ha.' A subsequent expansion to 6,400ha was a separate staking event, not part of this acquisition.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the project area is specified in the text: '...for an area of 5,650ha.'

resource_size.justification: The text does not contain a quantified mineral resource estimate (e.g., JORC or NI 43-101). It only mentions historical extraction of '<25tons of massive sulphide ore', which is not a current resource statement.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The acquiring company is identified in the text as 'Sorrento Resources Ltd. (CSE: SRS)'.
